name: get_macho_image
description: Inspect a Mach-O file (macOS executable, dylib or universal binary) that the process has mapped: identity (LC_UUID, architecture, platform and minimum OS), slices of a universal file, segments, linked libraries and entry point, and optionally one symbol by exact stored name (C names carry a leading underscore) or the symbol at a link-time address with its size. Reads the mapped file through bounded ranged reads; nothing is cached and the process's module list is unchanged. Not read: exports trie, chained fixups, compact unwind, DWARF, the dyld shared cache file format, 32-bit and big-endian images. Failures are typed: NotMachO, MachOUnsupported, MachOMalformed, MachOLimit, MachOArchitectureNotFound, MachOFileChanged; a table that cannot be read reports its own status. Synchronous mapped-file lookup above 131072 symbols reports limit. Indexed Darwin frame labels support the reader cap of 2097152 symbols. For a Darwin GDB target, provide only address: returns a runtime image/symbol label from the stopped stub image list and background UUID-verified local files (--exe, --debug-dir). Poll status pending; image_only retains the image offset and a typed diagnostic. Source lines and shared-cache symbols are unavailable.

address.description: Runtime address (hex) inside any mapping of the file, as listed by list_modules.

arch.description: Slice of a universal file; omitted takes the first arm64 or x86_64 slice.

symbol.description: Exact symbol name to look up.

symbol_address.description: Link-time address (hex, as stored in the file): the defined symbol covering it.

sections.description: Include the section list (at most 256 rows; default false).

process_id.description: Stable debugger process ID; omitted means original process 1, independent of GUI selection.
